Alt Text: Quiz card. Berlin or Vienna: which city portal scored higher? Two capital city portals, 20 pages each, analyzed by the same public-page review in October 2026. One of them leads by a single point. Scores hidden until tomorrow.
Comparison card. Berlin 86, Vienna 85. One point apart. Vienna leads SEO by 19 points, 94 to 75. Berlin answers in security, 86 to 72, and accessibility, 97 to 85. GEO, analytics and speed are tied.

Comparison card. Stanford, MIT, Harvard: each one wins somewhere. Stanford leads overall with 86, and in security. MIT has the fastest pages, 97 for speed. Harvard leads GEO with 89, and shares a perfect 100 for accessibility with Stanford.
Quiz card. Davivienda or Bancolombia: which bank's site scored higher? Two of Colombia's biggest banks, 20 public pages each, analyzed on the same day in October 2026. Scores hidden until tomorrow.

Comparison card. Davivienda 72, Bancolombia 65. The gap is accessibility. Davivienda scores 86 for accessibility, Bancolombia 45. Bancolombia has the faster pages, 73 to 50, and analytics is tied at 85.

Quiz card. GOV.UK or USA.gov: which national portal scored higher? Two national government portals, each built on a public design system, 20 pages each, analyzed in October 2026. Scores hidden until tomorrow.
Comparison card. GOV.UK 92, USA.gov 88. Both score 100 for accessibility. GOV.UK leads security, 94 to 77, and analytics, 97 to 85. USA.gov answers with speed, 94 to 89, and GEO, 91 to 86.

Quiz card. Medellín's metro or Bogotá's: which site scored higher? Medellín's metro has carried riders since 1995, while Bogotá's first line is still being built. Their websites, 20 pages each, went through the same review. Scores hidden until tomorrow.

Comparison card. Medellín 85, Bogotá 79. Bogotá's site is faster. Metro de Medellín leads SEO, 83 to 65, and security, 77 to 61. Metro de Bogotá wins speed, 97 to 94, and accessibility, 86 to 79. GEO is tied at 86.

Quiz card. Bogotá or Medellín: whose city hall site scored higher? Colombia's two largest cities and their official portals, analyzed by the same public-page review in October 2026. Scores hidden until tomorrow.
Comparison card. Bogotá 80, Medellín 74. Security made the difference. Bogotá leads security, 77 to 54, and SEO, 97 to 89. Medellín has the faster pages, 80 to 73, and edges GEO, 91 to 89.
